title: Sevmek, Sevilmek, Cinsellik
author: Nihan Kaya
description: Based on Nihan Kaya’s research at UCL’s Psychoanalysis Department, the book combines psychoanalysis, neuroscience and developmental psychology to explore how our earliest relationships shape the ways we love, form attachments and experience desire. Examining the emergence of the self, our unconscious femininity and masculinity, and the lasting influence of infancy and childhood, Kaya makes object relations theory accessible through a clear yet literary approach. The book presents sexuality as a mirror of the self while helping readers recognise, and potentially transform, the emotional patterns shaping their adult lives.
english_title: To Love, To Be Loved, and Sexuality
